# Audio fixtures

`silence.{mp3,flac,wav,aiff,m4a,ogg}` are **synthetic**: half a second of 8 kHz mono
silence each, generated by `generate.sh` with ffmpeg, with no tags and no encoder
strings. They contain no music and no personal data.

The `tagged*` clips are the same silence with made-up tags written by `tagged.py`
(mutagen), which `generate.sh` runs. They hold the layouts that tag writing must keep:

- `tagged-v24.mp3`: ID3v2.4 with cover art (a 16x16 grey PNG), MusicBrainz ids, an
  iTunes `iTunNORM` comment and a v2.4-only frame (`TSOP`).
- `tagged-v23-v1.mp3`: the same frames as ID3v2.3, plus an ID3v1 tag.
- `tagged-ape.mp3`: ID3v2.3, an APEv2 tag and an ID3v1 tag.
- `tagged.flac`: Vorbis comments and a picture block.
- `tagged.wav`, `tagged.aiff`: an ID3v2.3 chunk with the same frames.
- `tagged.m4a`: MP4 title and artist atoms.

Tests never modify these files. `tests/support/audio.py` copies a clip into a temporary
directory and writes the tags a test needs with mutagen.
